script_text: Aquarius, this week your Air element catches a cosmic spark, igniting your unique genius. Early on, Mercury in your 5th House squares Saturn, making Monday your worst day for creative risks. But Wednesday shines as Venus trines Jupiter in your 4th House, bringing romantic warmth and deep domestic harmony. The key shift hits Thursday as the Sun enters your 6th House, pivoting your energy toward focused career execution. Late week, Mars squares Pluto in your 10th House, signaling intense professional power plays and significant career shifts. The weekend softens with deeply supportive partnership energy in your 7th House, bringing emotional balance and stability. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Jupiter in your 4th House, bringing romantic breakthroughs. Monday is your worst day because Mercury squares Saturn, creating frustrating creative blocks. Focus your Uranus-driven innovation on your daily routine consistently. Follow for daily updates.
